relevance.rationale: Gauge-physics formulation of the non-abelian surface Stokes theorem expressing path-ordered Wilson loops as surface-ordered curvature integrals to compute exact loop averages in 2d Yang-Mills theory.

keyResults.locator: §II (Non-Abelian Stokes Theorem); §III-IV (2d Yang-Mills entangled Wilson loops)
keyResults.statement: Rewrites a path-ordered gauge holonomy around partial Sigma as a surface-ordered exponential of parallel-transported field strength and evaluates arbitrary entangled loop averages in 2d Yang-Mills.
keyResults.useForFolio: Physics counterpart to Yekutieli's non-abelian multiplicative surface integration in prop:mi-sw-abelianisation and lem:yekutieli-leading-coefficient.
